status: Primary-source research and proposed design; not experimental validation
constraint: Own randomly initialized CNN; procedural-only pretraining; one real reference and one support box per episode; no externally pretrained weights or natural-image pretraining.

sources.title: Pre-training without Natural Images
sources.math: Affine iterated-function systems generate labeled fractal families.
sources.budget: FractalDB-1k: 1,000 classes × 1,000 instances. ResNet-50, 90 epochs, batch256; natural-data fine-tuning follows.
sources.caveat: Evidence concerns transfer after natural-image fine-tuning, not one-reference category recognition.
sources.adoption: Established foundation for training our own CNN on synthetic geometry; record rendered images and exposures separately.

sources.title: Visual Atoms: Pre-training Vision Transformers with Sinusoidal Waves
sources.math: Elliptical contours multiplied by 1 plus two sinusoidal waves and periodic noise; quantized contour segments.
sources.budget: 1k/21k classes × 1,000 instances: 1M/21M images; pretraining300/90 epochs. Classification and COCO results follow natural-data fine-tuning.
sources.caveat: Primarily transformer evidence; 21k denotes classes, not images. No one-photo result.
sources.adoption: Use diverse contour frequencies, sizes and smoothness; our Gaussian generator is an adaptation, not a reproduction.

sources.title: Pre-training Vision Transformers with Very Limited Synthesized Images
sources.math: One base fractal per synthetic class, expanded through online pattern/texture augmentation.
sources.budget: OFDB-21k: 21,000 base images, 300,000 updates × batch1,024. Separate small-dataset experiment: 800 pretraining epochs, 200 natural-data fine-tuning epochs.
sources.caveat: One-instance means per synthetic class, not one photograph total. Few stored images can mean extensive compute.
sources.adoption: A small deterministic program bank is practical; count repeated augmented exposures.

sources.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
sources.publication: arXiv preprint v1; peer review not established
sources.math: Triplet hinge loss orders embeddings by distances between probability-weighted six-parameter IFS descriptors.
sources.budget: 1M FineFractalDB images; ResNet-50 134 epochs, ViT536. Retrieval gains follow natural-data Proxy-Anchor fine-tuning.
sources.caveat: Parameter/Chamfer ranking agreement47.2% unrestricted versus80.6% within-class. Not one-reference natural-photo evidence.
sources.adoption: Restrict continuous triplets to a compatible family and verify ordering against rendered geometry; do not equate parameter distance with semantics.

sources.title: Can You Learn to See Without Images? Procedural Warm-Up for Vision Transformers
sources.publication: arXiv v2; venue not established here
sources.math: Masked prediction on generated formal-language tokens, bypassing visual patch embeddings.
sources.budget: 15,000 steps × batch256, then300 epochs natural-image training; transfer experiments add50 fine-tuning epochs.
sources.caveat: Neither Gaussian-image learning nor CNN evidence; natural-image training supplies visual semantics.
sources.adoption: Conceptual motivation for relational synthetic tasks, not a direct implementation template.

sources.title: Fractals as Pre-training Datasets for Anomaly Detection and Localization
sources.math: Fractal classification pretraining supplies features to eight anomaly-detection methods.
sources.budget: 100,000 IFS codes grouped into1,000 classes; WideResNet50, 100 epochs × 1M images, batch512. Downstream MVTec/VisA normal-image training remains.
sources.caveat: ImageNet features win overall. Fixed-feature transfer is closer to our question, but anomaly detection is not one-photo category recognition.
sources.adoption: Retain low-level feature controls; attractive early-layer filters alone do not prove useful category embeddings.

implementation_hypotheses.formula: x=R(theta, nu); theta controls contour/topology, nu controls pose/color/background.
implementation_hypotheses.reason: Independent nuisance prevents class IDs becoming accidental background or color shortcuts. Texture descriptors remain available separately.

implementation_hypotheses.formula: u=G_sigma * epsilon; T(p)=p+alpha*u(p); enforce ||alpha*grad(u)||_op < 1 when claiming no folding.
implementation_hypotheses.reason: A displacement cap alone does not guarantee an invertible deformation. Reject blank/degenerate renderings and inspect coverage.

implementation_hypotheses.idea: Combine detail preservation and shape discrimination
implementation_hypotheses.reason: Detail targets come from the correctly transformed synthetic image; the shape head uses compatible-family geometry, with hard negatives sharing texture. This composite objective is our engineering proposal, not a quoted paper method.

implementation_hypotheses.formula: Example starting budget: 256–1024 deterministic base programs; batch32; 500–2000 steps; 32–64px patches.
implementation_hypotheses.reason: Budget is a proposed engineering choice, not an evidence-backed optimum or reproduction of large published schedules.

implementation_hypotheses.idea: Preserve procedural knowledge during one-photo adaptation
implementation_hypotheses.formula: Compare frozen synthetic backbone, head-only reference adaptation, and full reference adaptation.
implementation_hypotheses.reason: A support-only objective can overwrite transferable features. Use old development photos for selection, then freeze before new test photos.

reporting_requirements: Describe this as synthetic-only pretraining plus one real reference, not no pretraining or one image total.
Log RNG seeds, generator version, base programs, generated views, exposures, updates and checkpoint hash.
Count development calibration/query data separately from model training and freeze all choices before new test photos.
No cited source establishes our exact one-reference natural-photo category task or guarantees superiority.
originality: Formula-driven pretraining, Gaussian deformation, triplet learning and analytic detail targets are established ingredients. The testable contribution is their constrained integration and audited evaluation in HyperNet; priority or breakthrough is not established by this review.
